meta.title: Review Board source register
meta.rule: Every table row on this site links one entry below. `opened` records whether THIS session fetched and read the page on 2026-11-13; `carried` means the URL and its finding come from a sibling hub's register (that hub's own capture date is shown) and were not re-read here. Values that no listed source supports are left blank and appear on the Flagged for Review page.

classes.official-nfl: Published by the National Football League on an NFL-controlled host.
classes.nfl-operations: Published by NFL Football Operations (rulebook, policy documents).
classes.third-party-feed: Community or vendor data used as an input; not an NFL publication.
classes.repository: A file committed in this repository - evidence of what the system computed, not of an external fact.

meta.reachability_rule: A source marked reachable: false is never rendered as a hyperlink on this site. Its URL is printed as text so a reader can see what was tried, and no claim on any page cites it as support.

sources.label: NFL official Week 10 2026 injury report
sources.page_title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: All player rows, positions, injuries, practice participation and game statuses on the Injury tracking and Depth & deficiency pages; the 28-team slate for Week 10; team records printed beside each matchup.
sources.note: Read in full (8 chunks). The page prints each club's record next to the matchup, which is how the records on this site were checked without a second source.

sources.label: NFL 2026 division standings
sources.supports: All 32 team records, points for/against and streaks shown on the Current slate table.
sources.note: The 28 clubs playing in Week 10 reconcile 28/28 with the records printed on the injury-report page; the 4 clubs not in the report (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB) are taken from the standings page alone.

sources.label: NFL Week 10 2026 schedule
sources.page_title: NFL Week 10 Schedule 2026: Games, Times, Matchups & Tickets
sources.supports: Kickoff slots, broadcast partners and the Thursday result (Commanders 24, Giants 21, Final).
sources.note: The league labels the Nov 12-16 slate as Week 10 (reg10), which is the week number used throughout this hub.

sources.label: NFL news roundup - Friday, Nov 13, 2026
sources.page_title: NFL news roundup: Ravens confirm Lamar Jackson expected to miss 6-10 weeks; Kenneth Walker questionable
sources.supports: Ravens QB timeline (6-10 weeks, surgery for a broken and dislocated thumb, per coach Jesse Minter); per-team Friday status notes used in the report-vs-roundup comparison.
sources.note: Chunk 0 of 4 read; the per-team items quoted on this site all appear in the portion read.

sources.label: 2026 NFL Rulebook (NFL Football Operations)
sources.supports: What Rule 19-2 actually covers in the current edition (disqualification consultation), used to check a citation in a sibling hub.
sources.note: Reached by redirect from operations.nfl.com/the-rules/nfl-rulebook/. The page also lists the four 2026 rule changes (6-1-3, 6-1-5, 6-1-6, 19-2).

sources.label: NFL injury-report policy page (dead)
sources.supports: Nothing - the page returns a 404. Recorded so the missing policy citation is not re-invented by the next session.
sources.note: Carried flag re-checked today: the path siblings cite is dead, so the Wednesday/Friday/Saturday reporting cadence could not be confirmed from an official page in this session and is published as unverified.

sources.label: NFL latest injury report (landing path)
sources.page_title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: That the live 'latest' report is the Week 10 report, and that its title and body agree on the week number.
sources.note: Prior sessions flagged a title/body week mismatch on archived weeks. As of this capture, title ('Week 10'), heading ('Injuries - WEEK 10') and URL (reg10) agree.

sources.label: This repository at the review base commit
sources.supports: Every count on the Hub map, Repo review and Reconciliation pages (directories, pages, JSON registers, nav labels, register sizes) - all computed from this commit.
sources.note: The board's 14 session sections and 541 tracked files are read from here, not summarised.

sources.label: Line Lab committed pipeline results (data/derived)
sources.supports: Model-vs-close benchmark numbers, leaderboard state, correlation coefficients and the luck measurements quoted on the Strategy programme and Reconciliation pages.
sources.note: Read-only. Third-party community extracts underlie these files, so they evidence what this repository computed, not an NFL-published fact.

sources.label: nflverse data releases (community feed)
sources.opened: carried - recorded by sibling hubs (2026-11-01 / 2026-11-12), not re-opened by this session
sources.supports: The provenance of the game, schedule and weekly-stat extracts the pipeline consumes. No value on this site is attributed to the NFL through this feed.
sources.note: Labelled third-party wherever it appears, per the project's source rule.

sources.label: Sibling hub registers (suggestions, questions, leaderboards, injuries)
sources.supports: Every proposal row and question row in the review queue, the Week 10 Wednesday capture used for the day-over-day delta, and the per-hub verdict counts.
sources.note: Seven hubs expose machine-readable registers: decision-desk, decision-hub, lineup-lab, nfl-command, site, suggestions, verify-hub. Each row in the queue links its own hub register.

sources.label: This hub's programme register
sources.supports: Anything authored here rather than measured elsewhere: the phase sequence, the review rules, signals SIG-01 to SIG-07, gates G11 and G12, and the competition design.
sources.note: A proposal's source is the file that states it. Marking it 'repository' says plainly that no external page has confirmed it yet.
